item.title: Obituary: Larry Lee Marr June 5, 1952 – Nov. 24, 2025
item.description: LARRY LEE MARR June 5, 1952 – Nov. 24, 2025 Larry Lee Marr, 73, of Los Alamos, N.M., began his next journey on Monday, November 24, 2025, after a short hospital stay in Albuquerque. He was preceded in death by his parents, Robert and Virginia Marr. He is survived by his wife, Jean Marr, and son, Tyler Marr. item.title: LAMC Brings Back Shining Rooftop Christmas Tree!
item.description: Since at least 1980, Los Alamos Medical Center (LAMC) has celebrated the holiday season in a special way — by placing a Christmas tree on the top roof. item.title: 2025 Hunger Walk & Turkey Trot Raises More Than $9,000
item.description: By CYNTHIA BIDDLECOMB CROP Walk Organizing Committee The “2025 Annual Los Alamos CROP Hunger Walk and Turkey Trot” was held on a day with questionable weather, Sunday, Nov. 23. Despite overnight snow, by 2 p.m. the 1.77 to 2.57 mile course had cleared. About 90 enthusiastic people ran or walked it. Results of the runners’ times and places were published recently (link).
